title: Add 'mark complete' action to TasksApp
description: Add a keyboard shortcut 'm' in TasksApp to mark the selected task as complete. Writes the change to tasks.json and refreshes the list.
acceptanceCriteria: Pressing 'm' on an incomplete task sets passes:true in tasks.json
Task list refreshes to reflect the change immediately
A success flash message is shown after marking complete
Pressing 'm' on an already-complete task has no effect

steps.details: In useInput: if (input === 'm') { const task = filteredTasks[selectedIndex]; if (task && !task.passes) { handleMarkComplete(task.id) } }
async function handleMarkComplete(id: number) { const updated = markTaskComplete(tasks, id); await writeTasks(agentDir, updated); setTasks(updated); setFlash(`Task #${id} marked complete`) }

Add flash state: const [flash, setFlash] = useState<string | null>(null). When flash is set, show it for 2 seconds then clear: setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), 2000). Render flash at the bottom of the TUI: {flash && <Text color='green'>{flash}</Text>}

technicalNotes: Tasks state must be stored in React state (not just read once) to allow re-renders after modifications
